name: Neon Kaleidoscope
description: Draw with your finger and every stroke is mirrored eight ways in glowing neon.
prompt: A neon kaleidoscope drawing app: draw with your finger and every stroke is mirrored in 8-way symmetry with glowing neon trails, sparkles and colors that slowly shift. Include an autoplay mode that draws by itself, and buttons to clear and change the symmetry.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Dibuja con el dedo y cada trazo se refleja ocho veces en neón brillante.
